primaryComparison: Compare 365 and 120 days of half-life in the goal rates and league frequency together, with the same history, prior-season multiplier, smoothing and calibration coefficients.
diagnostics: Change only the goal rates or only the league frequency to show how each calibration input responds. All variants use identical matches.
historicalGate: Upper paired 95% Log Loss difference versus the 120-day calibration below zero, lower Brier than the 120-day calibration and lower Log Loss than the 120-day league frequency. Prospective evaluation is required for promotion.
